The skipping happens in the filter engine in `src/filter.zig`, and it covers both directories and files.

- `src/filter.zig:244`: `if (self.skip_hidden and dir_name.len > 0 and dir_name[0] == '.')` checks directory names for a leading dot.
- `src/filter.zig:268`: `if (self.skip_hidden and file_name.len > 0 and file_name[0] == '.')` does the same for file names.

How the flag gets there:
- `src/main.zig:1419` sets `opts.skip_hidden = true`. The context doesn't show the `--no-hidden` string itself, but this is presumably the parsing branch.
- `src/main.zig:2385` and `src/main.zig:2505` copy it into `filter_engine.skip_hidden`.

What the context doesn't show is the body of those `if` blocks (for example, whether the directory check prunes the whole subtree) or the callers of the two checks. So I can confirm both checks exist, but not exactly what they do on a match.
